question.question: If Charismatic must Recruit but only one Eyrie warrior remains in supply, can placing that one fulfill the Decree?

expected.expected_answer: No. Charismatic requires two; inability fully complete causes immediate turmoil despite maximum-possible piece placement.

source_passages.section: FAQ & Rulings — Charismatic and a supply shortage
source_passages.quotation: - **Charismatic and a supply shortage:** When a legal Decree Recruit requires two warriors but only one remains in supply, place that warrior first. Then enter Turmoil because the required two were not placed. Maximum-possible placement does not fulfill an incomplete Decree action. (FAQ under 7.7 and 7.8.2; Law 1.5.4.)

answer.ruling: If Charismatic’s Decree Recruit requires two warriors but only one remains in supply, place that one first, then enter Turmoil because the required two were not placed. The maximum possible placement does not fulfill the incomplete Decree action.
